nodes.name: Pt2CoCu impregnation and annealing
nodes.procedure: 50 mg BP2000, 20 mg H₂PtCl₆·6H₂O, 6.4 mg CoCl₂·6H₂O, and 3.9 mg CuCl₂·2H₂O was first mixed in a 100 mL roundbottom flask containing 40 mL DI water. After stirring overnight, the mixture was subjected to ultrasonic treatment for 2 h before drying by using a rotary evaporator. Finally, the dried powder was transferred to a tube furnace and thermally reduced at 1000 °C under flowing 5% H₂/Ar for 2 h.

nodes.name: Pt2CoNi impregnation and annealing
nodes.procedure: The Pt₂CoNi IMC catalysts were prepared with the BP2000 carbon black support by a conventional impregnation method that involved the wetness impregnation of metal salt and subsequent thermal reduction in 5% H₂/Ar (identical procedure to Pt₂CoCu but substituting CuCl₂·2H₂O with NiCl₂·6H₂O). 50 mg BP2000, 20 mg H₂PtCl₆·6H₂O, 6.4 mg CoCl₂·6H₂O, and corresponding amount of NiCl₂·6H₂O was first mixed in a 100 mL roundbottom flask containing 40 mL DI water. After stirring overnight, the mixture was subjected to ultrasonic treatment for 2 h before drying by using a rotary evaporator. Finally, the dried powder was transferred to a tube furnace and thermally reduced at 1000 °C under flowing 5% H₂/Ar for 2 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: Both Pt₂CoCu and Pt₂CoNi show L1₀-type intermetallic structures with characteristic superlattice peaks at ~24° and 33°; crystallite sizes 2.94 nm (Pt₂CoCu) and 3.19 nm (Pt₂CoNi).
nodes.evidence_snippet: We first performed the powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) characterizations to verify the L1₀-type intermetallic structures ... two characteristic super-lattice peaks at around 24° and 33° were found in the Pt₂CoCu and Pt₂CoNi samples, indicating the formation of the L1₀ structures.

nodes.characterization_summary: Both Pt₂CoCu/Pt₂CoNi IMC nanoparticles homogeneously distributed on carbon with narrow size distribution 1.5-4 nm; average sizes 2.62 nm (Pt₂CoCu) and 2.73 nm (Pt₂CoNi).
nodes.evidence_snippet: HAADF-STEM revealed that Pt₂CoCu/Pt₂CoNi IMC nanoparticles were homogeneously distributed over the whole carbon matrix ... Statistical analyses suggested a narrow particle size distribution of Pt₂CoCu/Pt₂CoNi catalysts in the range of 1.5-4 nm, with average size of 2.62 and 2.73 nm, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Both Pt₂CoCu and Pt₂CoNi show homogeneous distributions of Pt and non-noble metal elements in individual nanoparticles without element segregation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) elemental mapping with a large visual field indicated the homogeneous distributions of Pt and other non-noble metal elements in individual nanoparticles without element segregation (Fig. 4a, b).

nodes.characterization_summary: Atomic-resolution aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM confirms ordered L1₀ structure for both Pt₂CoCu and Pt₂CoNi with alternating bright Pt/dark non-noble metal columns.
nodes.evidence_snippet: We then performed aberration-corrected HAADF-STEM with atomic resolution to verify the ordered structure of the Pt₂CoCu/Pt₂CoNi catalysts ... we could observe an alternating bright and dark stacking of Pt and non-noble metal columns.
